steps.title: Greet the chapter
steps.description: Begin with a few deep breaths and read the One God overview while thinking about what divine unity feels like.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask Allah to help you notice how the oneness of God shows up in your day-to-day, even in small moments.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Plan one quiet pause later where you can repeat the chapter’s image of unity and let it settle.

steps.title: Greet the chapter
steps.description: Approach the Qur'an section with curiosity, letting the opening summary settle like a calm melody.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask for ease in connecting with the text and for patience when verses feel new or dense.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Schedule a brief reflection later to reread a favorite line and note how it touched you.

steps.title: Greet the chapter
steps.description: Invite the Prophet’s story in by slowing down over the introduction and imagining standing beside his companions.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask for Allah’s help to see the Prophet’s patience in a new light and to feel companionship with his mercy.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Plan to revisit a short anecdote later and reflect on how it might shape a kind choice today.

steps.title: Greet the chapter
steps.description: Read the Main Practices overview calmly, noting which ritual speaks to you right now.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask for openness to explore both familiar and unfamiliar acts of worship without pressure.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Schedule a quick break to jot down one practice you’d like to try in a gentle, manageable way.

steps.title: Greet the chapter
steps.description: Let the Prayer chapter welcome you with slow reading, imagining each movement as a soft rhythm.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask to experience prayer as a conversation, not a performance, and to notice how your breath can anchor you.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Plan a mindful moment later to close your eyes, breathe, and silently repeat one phrase from the chapter.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Plan a short reflection to notice how restraint and generosity feel in your own life.

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask to become more mindful of patience, kindness, or honesty in one interaction today.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Schedule a moment to reflect on a recent choice and how you can gently improve next time.

steps.title: Set a soft intention

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause

steps.title: Set a soft intention
steps.description: Ask for the courage to keep striving, just as each prophet did despite challenges.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
steps.description: Plan a brief reflection to choose one prophetic example you’ll keep in mind today.

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause

steps.title: Capture a gentle pause
